overview.headlineHtml: A detached villa on the golf front line
copy: El Campanario Golf Villa is a single detached house on the golf front line at El Campanario, Estepona, arranged over a semi-basement, ground floor and first floor with a private pool and garden.

The ground floor holds an open living and dining room of 37.90 sqm with a separate 23.60 sqm dining area and a 16.00 sqm kitchen, opening to a 28.06 sqm covered porch, a 31.75 sqm solarium and the pool. Two bedrooms sit on the first floor and two more in the semi-basement, alongside a 24.30 sqm media room and a 14.34 sqm games room. Planning permission has been granted and the developer gives delivery as Q4 2026 to Q1 2027.

why.copy: A detached golf-front villa with its own pool, at a price point where much of the market is townhouses or apartments. It is the last villa in its phase.
points: Buyers who want a detached house with a private plot and pool, on the golf, rather than a unit in a scheme.
A full semi-basement with a media room and games room, lit by a sunken patio, which adds living space most villas at this size do not have.
El Campanario sits on the golf between Estepona and Puerto Banus, with the clubhouse, its restaurant and racquet courts a short walk away.
One villa remains in this phase.

copy: The developer publishes a full quality specification. The points below are taken from it, not from marketing copy.
highlights: Reinforced concrete slab foundation, metal pillars and waffle slabs, with 25 cm reinforced basement walls.
Anodised black aluminium with thermal break, low-emissivity outer glazing and 4+4 acoustic inner glazing.
Ducted inverter heat pump across three zones, underfloor heating and aerothermal hot water.
70x70 cm porcelain on the ground floor, wood-effect vinyl above, wood-effect porcelain on the porch and terraces.
Handleless units with a 4 cm laminate worktop; oven, induction hob, fridge freezer, extractor and dishwasher included.
Gunite pool lined in porcelain with salt chlorinator, printed concrete driveway, automated sliding gate and irrigated planting.

lifestyle.copy: El Campanario is an established golf urbanisation between Estepona and Puerto Banus, with its clubhouse a short walk from the villa.
panels: A restaurant, tennis and padel courts, spa, gym and pool sit within the urbanisation.
The villa fronts the course, with the fairway directly beyond the pool terrace.
The nearest beach is a short drive south; the routed distances are listed beside the map.
